purpose: Independent facility-educator clinical review packet for external-training/go-live gating.
current_project_review_state: Single-reviewer clinical review complete by project author/practicing ECMO specialist; independent external review pending.
gate_rule: External-training/go-live remains blocked until all current CBCs receive an independent disposition and no unresolved REJECT_REWORK disposition remains.

items.learner_exposure: direct — generic intravascular volume and ECMO RPM are learner-operable
review_questions: Are the preconditions a plausible non-chattering teaching baseline?
Are the expected directions for preload, patient flow, MAP, CVP and drainage pressure appropriate?
Is RPM escalation correctly framed as non-definitive/worsening drainage under preload limitation?
Are allowed exceptions and non-claims sufficient to prevent treating the regression stimulus as a treatment threshold?
items.device_or_policy_evidence: not required for directional contract; local volume-resuscitation policy must be separate from regression stimuli

review_questions: Is complete zero sweep correctly represented as loss of both membrane O2 addition and CO2 removal?
Are nonzero sweep and FdO2 roles kept appropriately separate?
Is the membrane-boundary validation acceptable while coupled-patient venous-state limitations remain disclosed?
items.device_or_policy_evidence: device/manufacturer gas-path operating evidence desirable before device-specific claims

items.learner_exposure: direct — CKRT Qb and net UF are learner-operable
review_questions: Is UF gating on CKRT selected + Qb>0 appropriate for the intended simulator workflow?
Are matched-control volume/preload consequences appropriate?
Is stopping UF correctly distinguished from replacing lost volume?
Are the current Qb/net-UF values clearly retained as regression stimuli rather than prescriptions?
items.device_or_policy_evidence: validated prescription ranges/institutional CKRT practice required before dose/range claims

items.learner_exposure: direct — pressure-control ventilation including PEEP is learner-operable
review_questions: Is higher positive airway pressure correctly taught as capable of lowering native output/MAP while measured CVP rises?
Is the non-volume interpretation of CVP clear?
Is the PEEP-to-ECMO drainage block adequate until transmural preload exists?
Are re-equilibration and recruitment/derecruitment limitations clearly separated?
items.device_or_policy_evidence: device-specific ventilator accuracy not required for directional contract; local ventilation policy separate

review_questions: Is the separation of FdO2-driven O2 effect from sweep-driven CO2 effect appropriate?
Is deriving saturation from the same modeled PO2 state acceptable as a consistency rule?
Is coupled-patient oxygenation correctly blocked until true venous inlet state exists?
items.device_or_policy_evidence: device-specific transfer data required before quantitative transfer claims

review_questions: Is total-flow-versus-patient-flow diversion represented in the right direction?
Is venous CDI contamination by recirculated post-oxygenator blood an appropriate teaching relationship?
Are bridge target flows clearly regression stimuli rather than bedside targets?
items.device_or_policy_evidence: institution/circuit-specific bridge management and sensor-location policy required before target-flow, flush/flash, or device-specific CDI claims

review_questions: Does OPEN vs inline HEMOFILTER vs side-port CKRT match the intended circuit topology?
Is filter presence correctly separated from scuffing activity?
Is leaving hemofilter patient UF blocked appropriate until a bounded prescription exists?
items.device_or_policy_evidence: device-specific filter resistance and institutional setup evidence needed before quantitative/device claims

items.learner_exposure: indirect/headless — no complete persistent oxygenator-fault action yet
review_questions: Is separating hydraulic obstruction from gas-transfer impairment correct?
Are universal Delta-P thresholds appropriately excluded?
Are restoration semantics correctly identified as deterministic while no persistent fault state exists?
items.device_or_policy_evidence: device-specific pressure/transfer curves required before thresholds or change criteria

items.learner_exposure: indirect/headless — blood-loss mechanism exists but no learner bleeding-source control
review_questions: Are serial blood-loss and partial-replacement relationships appropriate?
Is cessation correctly represented only as absence of further loss events in the current model?
Are coagulation/transfusion/source-control limitations explicit enough?
items.device_or_policy_evidence: institutional transfusion/coagulation policies required before treatment claims

items.learner_exposure: indirect/headless — no typed kink/position fault action
review_questions: Is the always-open-shunt interpretation of patient-flow/shunt-fraction changes appropriate?
Is omitting a mandatory more-negative P1 response correct for this topology?
Are kink, common pre-pump obstruction and positional maldrainage correctly kept separate/blocked?
items.device_or_policy_evidence: device-specific cannula curves required before quantitative claims

items.learner_exposure: headless/runtime mechanism — no learner inotrope or myocardial control
review_questions: Are LV and RV directional failure phenotypes appropriate?
Is the nonlinear response across contractility scales acceptable for teaching?
What labels, if any, can be safely attached to scale values?
Are filling-pressure/chamber-volume interpretations appropriately bounded?
items.device_or_policy_evidence: not device-specific; clinical phenotype/severity mapping requires expert review
